records.notes: Visible forms show وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Bazzi/Qunbul, وَالنُّبُوٓءَةَ in Warsh/Qalun, and وَالنُّبُوَّةَ with prefixed alif presentation in Duri/Susi; the Warsh/Qalun lexical form is a clear reading difference.
Visible forms show تَجۡعَلُونَهُۥ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Warsh/Qalun and يَجۡعَلُونَهُۥ in Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi.
Visible forms show تُبۡدُونَهَا in Hafs/Shu'bah/Warsh/Qalun and يُبۡدُونَهَا in Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi.
Visible forms show وَتُخۡفُونَ in Hafs/Shu'bah/Warsh/Qalun and وَيُخۡفُونَ in Bazzi/Duri/Qunbul/Susi.
The visible forms share مُبَارَكٞ lexically; Warsh/Qalun show dagger-alif presentation مُبَٰرَكٞ while the other editions show مُبَارَكٞ.
